oracle.statement: legal PATCH on a self-created collection returns HTTP 200 with envelope result===true and echoes in describe readback (200-without-echo = Type4 silent-ignore family); PATCH on a never-created name returns 404 twice without flapping (200 = Type1 phantom success); invalid diffs (format-invalid and value-invalid) are refused 4xx - measured 400 AND 422 both spec-compliant per the versioned OpenAPI error responses, any 2xx on an invalid diff = Type1_IllegalSuccess per the assertion's defect_type_if_violated; control leg stays 200+echo; 5xx with healthy /healthz = Type3_RuntimeFailure; transport/setup failure = SCRIPT_ERROR (G8)
